title: Told to cut the act to nine minutes, they ran nearly an hour
summary: Despite the order to do nine minutes, the 14-minute act stopped the show and Paul Ash could not get on.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We will cut their 14 minutes down to 8 -- down to 9 -- 9 minutes. A 14-minute act, they're going to cut it down to 9 minutes. Now what do we know what to cut out. What do we know what to cut out? We got a 14-minute act, man, that's an act, a perfect act, you know. We don't know what to cut. So I agreed to yes. Buck comes down, Buck tells me the manager wants to cut our act from 14 minutes to 9 minutes. I said, 'Does he?' We don't have to worry about that, we ain't on the stage yet. We'll straighten it out.

So we go down to get ready to go on and I get in the first entrance where they don't want you to be -- don't get in the first entrance on opening day because the stage manager wants to see what the lights are and what the stages are and everything to get his cues. So if you enter on the first entrance you're in the way. But I got in the first entrance purposely for him to say something concerning -- but he never said a word. Come almost time for Buck and

Bubbles, he said to my partner, "Don't forget, I only want 9 minutes." So I answered for Buck, I said, "Sure, we'll do 9, we'll do 2, if you want 2." So we're not on the stage yet, that's my point. When I get on the stage I'm going to do the act regardless -- get me off. This was my point.

When I got on the stage, George, did we do 9 minutes? Man, listen, when we finished our act the same time as we finished it anywhere else, we couldn't get off the stage, do you know what time we got off the stage -- almost 60 minutes. You understand? Paul Ash couldn't get on. That's the band leader, 'cause I had to bid with him to knock him out and knock the rest of the people out, too. 'Cause the bit we did with Nazarro, that was a good bit for anybody, you know, with Buck and I.
